upper_bricks.merge_method: all original native BoxMesh VERTEX/NORMAL/TANGENT/UV arrays concatenated in row/column order; every original INDEX offset by actual preceding vertex count; no dropped attribute or geometry reduction
upper_bricks.method: lo=-2.5+column*.25+odd*.125; hi=min(lo+.25,2.5); odd first lo=-2.5; center=(lo+hi)/2; BoxMesh stored arrays translated, no custom fake-normal brick grid

upper_wall_geometry_revision.support_method: Actual used-index minimum2% over complete new native bounds; require old/new support vector/count/minY byteexact, not old bbox alpha equality.
upper_wall_geometry_revision.support_scope: Complete new used-index minimum2% algorithm, not retained subset-only measurement.
